title: [ExpenseAgent] Expose VatSpecifications on Expense API Page
summary: The Expense API page now exposes VAT specifications through a new part, and a new capability is added to the Expense Agent for backwards compatibility.
key_points: New VAT Specifications part added to the Expenses API page
New value added to the Expense Capability enum
